Intro abre el barrio: guardia fija, refu: Enter opens the neighborhood: standing guard, reinforcements, investing and setting it on the GPS. Loyalty and defense go from 0 to 100. Intro abre lo que puedes hacer con esta: Enter opens what you can do with this gang: hit their hideout or make a truce. Their strength grows every day; when it's enough, they prepare an attack. With level 2 informants you see the exact figure.
Intro sube un nivel; la opción siguiente: Enter raises a level; the next option lowers it. Each level costs the same every midnight, and the first day is paid when you hire. Level 1: the rumor, a day ahead. Level 2: a tip two days ahead, with the gang, and you see each gang's exact strength. Level 3: a phone message as soon as they decide, with day, time and strength. Without informants, a neighborhood with high loyalty also warns you: at 50, like level 1; at 75, like level 2. If one midnight you can't pay them, they leave.

Here you see the threat, loyalty and defense of each one, set guards and reinforcements, pay informants, make truces, hit hideouts and, when they attack, send your crew. Inside, the first option explains everything.
Las bandas que has vencido se están reha: The gangs you've beaten are rebuilding and will try to take back what's theirs. You have {dias} of calm. After that, when a gang attacks a neighborhood, you'll have a few hours to go and defend it in person or to send your crew from the phone; if you do nothing, you lose it. Get ready on the phone, in Territories, Neighborhood defense: there you put guards, reinforce a neighborhood, pay informants who warn you in time, make truces and hit hideouts. And visit your neighborhoods now and then: an abandoned one falls sooner. If you'd rather it didn't happen, turn it off in Options, The street.
Las bandas que has vencido se rehacen co: The gangs you've beaten rebuild as the days go by and try to take back your neighborhoods. When one attacks a neighborhood, you're always notified and you have a few hours: go there and defend it in person, in waves and with your gang by your side, or send your crew from this menu, and the result is worked out from their strength against your defense, plus luck. If you do nothing, the standing guard defends on its own, if there is one; if not, the neighborhood is lost, along with its daily money and some street reputation, and you'll have to reconquer it. The deadline doesn't run while you're on a mission, and if you sleep or end up in the hospital or the holding cell, your crew holds out: when you come back you always have a few hours left. A neighborhood's defense goes up with standing guards, who are paid every day, with reinforcements, which are paid once, with its loyalty and with the people of your gang. Loyalty drops if days go by without you setting foot in the neighborhood, and rises when you visit it, defend it or invest in it. Informants are paid every day and warn you ahead of time: without them, you find out late or when they've already arrived. With a gang you can make a truce for a few days, or hit their hideout to sink their strength. A gang beaten several times is dismantled for a long spell, but someone new always ends up arriving. There are never two attacks at once and there are always a few days of rest between one and the next. The intensity is chosen in Options, The street: off, calm, normal or hard.
Les pagas y durante unos días no asaltan: You pay them and for a few days they don't attack your neighborhoods, and they rebuild half as fast. If they were preparing an attack, they drop it. They ask for more the stronger they are and the worse you get along; you can haggle once. The truce can be broken: by them, some day, without warning, or by you, if you hit their hideout.
